verdict.rationale: Fireworks' fine-tuning docs say customers keep the weights they train, which is a first-party portability commitment for trained artifacts. Its OpenAI-compatible API and SFT data format also lower lock-in. However, nothing documents an actual export or download path for weights, datasets, or other account data, or the formats those exports would use. Missing for 10: a documented weight/model download mechanism, dataset and account-data export, explicit open export formats, a full-account export or offboarding process, and independent confirmation that leaving works in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
